newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF urges DKB to do more to regain public trust.
newsitem.headline: MOF urges DKB to do more to regain public trust.

text.p: Japan's Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd should do more than just change its top management to restore public trust in the bank, Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka told a news conference on Tuesday.
"The bank should do everything to recover trust. It should not just leave it at personnel changes," he said.
DKB should conduct a thorough internal inspection to get to the bottom of the matter and then make its findings public in order to restore its creditability, he said.
Asked whether the government was going to leave DKB off the syndicate that underwrites bonds, he said it was not the right time to make a decision on that issue.
